mappings.explanation: The shared controls check specific high-risk ClusterRole grants and bindings. The Catalog rule also asks for a broader chart and target policy review.
Both checks find Services whose selectors match no rendered Deployment or StatefulSet. The Catalog rule also covers StatefulSet serviceName references.
The shared control finds an omitted tag or latest. The Catalog rule also treats chart-specific moving labels such as auto as mutable.
The shared control finds privileged Deployment containers. The Catalog rule can also cover privileged containers in other workload kinds.
The shared controls check concrete StatefulSet security, resource, token, and PVC-retention fields. The Catalog rule also asks for storage, upgrade, and rollback decisions.
The shared control finds sensitive values stored directly in workload environment fields. The Catalog rules also cover Secret ownership, generated material, rotation, and target-specific replacement.
The shared controls check concrete Deployment availability, resources, security, storage, and token fields. The Catalog rule also asks for target-specific rollout policy.
The shared control finds host namespaces on Deployments. The Catalog rule can cover the same setting on other workload kinds.
The shared controls check hostPath use and concrete DaemonSet security, resource, and token fields. The Catalog rules also cover node access, storage behavior, rollout, and observation.

intentionallyUnmapped.reason: These checks depend on install order, controller behavior, target state, or observations. A static rendered-object scan cannot replace them.
These checks depend on chart source, values, dependencies, or target-supplied settings that are not fully represented by the rendered objects.
These are broader operating and ownership decisions. Shared field checks can inform the review but do not answer it.
The current shared static bundle has no maintained equivalent for this exact Catalog check.
